summary: LGL Group filed an 8-K announcing a transferable subscription rights offering. Each holder of record as of June 4, 2026 receives one right per share, allowing the purchase of one share at a price equal to the greater of (i) a 1%-5% discount to the 30-day VWAP ending June 3, 2026, or (ii) $6.81 (book value per share as of March 31, 2026). Up to 6,540,435 new shares may be issued. Rights trade on NYSE American under 'LGL RT'. An oversubscription privilege is available only to primary rights holders. The offering expires June 23, 2026. Watch for the subscription price determination, secondary market trading of rights, and potential dilution risk.
